description: This file contains tests for a FastAPI application, particularly testing query parameter parsing, route responses, and API schema correctness. It includes fixtures to set up test clients with different Python versions, parameterized tests for various API endpoints, and validation of the OpenAPI schema.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the test parameter and creates a TestClient instance for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_read_user_item(client: TestClient, path, expected_json)
methods.description: Parameterized test that verifies API responses for different user item endpoints and query parameters.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that retrieves and validates the OpenAPI schema of the FastAPI application.
